title: mesh laundry bags
text: mesh laundry bags. Not just for laundry!  I purchase the large size of the freezer shock packs and these bags fit them perfectly!  The bags help to protect the shock pack AND keep the sharp edges away from skin.  Win/win!  Hint on the bags.. if you use them as I did, slide the shock packs into the mesh bags before filling the shock pack.  Super fast and easy.  The zipper is a sturdy closure.  I think they will work really well.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
